author: Yffe
content: Replace the textual dedupe (lowered.ends_with('as <cast>')) with a structural condition at all 3 spec_call_param_cast consumers (lower_inv_expr Call arm; lower_expr Call arm arith + nat-len branches). New helper arg_is_toplevel_cast_to(arg, cast): skip the REQ-5 narrowing iff the arg AST is top-level Expr::Cast{ty} with lower_type(ty)==cast (a genuine re-narrow ((x) as u32)). A Binary/Unary or .len() arg is never a top-level cast -> always narrowed, fixing the k + j as u32 = k + (j as u32) int-typed false-skip (E0308 -> L0). Goldens stable: top-level-cast arg s(x as u32) still emits ONE cast.
